name: Kaijin
source:
Princess Vermea of Owls, a small peaceful country, wanted to become a good ruler like her father.
But one night, a fire broke out in the castle.
It was here that Vermea witnessed someone sneaked in and kill her father, taking the advantage of the chaos.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9698]official site[/url]]
